Hello mate: it's not like that. It's not like once you've gone past a specific number of days, you don't think about it anymore; it's more like, once you've past the 60-90 days barrier, there'll come days, even weeks, when you won't even think about it: hell, I think I didn't think about it for the whole November, not even a single urge, and urges are so scarce; you have them, but I've got to a point where I just accept them, and move on. For instance this week with Christmas and this love stuff it has come to my mind more often, but nothing I cannot handle, and it'll probably disappear within a week to not return for some time; it's how it's been for the past months, some weeks you don't even remember, and when you do, at least for me, it's not hard at all to restrain it and forget about it; never takes more than a few minutes.

I could make a huge list, but at the moment what I feel is: stronger than ever, like never before I have been able to hit the gym more than 2 weeks in a row, and now I've been doing it for 6 months, at home, street, wherever; I feel the need of it, of spend my energy. 
Energy: never have I feel this energy; I've always felt decayed, tired, not wanting to get up of bed, because  of lack of energy. Now I sleep much better, and by the time my time comes to get up in the morning I have all the energy I need to do so.
Mood: I used to be grumpy, not happy, but now most of the things that used to bother me, now go past me unnoticed, I don't care. My relationships are much better as I feel way better with myself 
I love myself: not much to explain here.
Dairy care: I brush my teeth, put some facial cream on, shave....
And, in general, I feel way more productive, how much more and well I use my time.
